overloadMerges.note: The docs render two syntax lines that differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether 'object' is an object-name string vs. a form variable reference). That's one semantic overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator, not two independent overloads.

params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box, column, header, or footer.

params.name: width
params.description: New width of the object, in pixels.

params.name: minWidth
params.description: Minimum width the user can manually resize the column to, in pixels.

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: Maximum width the user can manually resize the column to, in pixels.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets the width of a list box, or of one column/header, and optionally its manual-resize limits.

constraints: If object designates the whole list box, all columns are resized; if it designates a column or column header, only that column is resized.
Passing the same value in width, minWidth, and maxWidth prevents the user from manually resizing the column.
